# Bootstrap Icons subset

Source: [Bootstrap Icons official repository](https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.11.3), fixed version **v1.11.3**.

Downloaded on 2026-10-16 from the upstream raw files. The four SVG files and `LICENSE` are unmodified. No package was installed. These icons use a 16 × 16 viewBox and `currentColor`.
